final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT ac.frequency, d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM disp AS d JOIN account AS ac ON d.account_id = ac.account_id GROUP BY d.account_id, ac.frequency), frequency_sums AS (SELECT frequency, SUM(row_count) AS total_count FROM account_counts GROUP BY frequency), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(total_count) AS avg_count FROM frequency_sums) SELECT fs.frequency, fs.total_count, fs.total_count - oa.avg_count AS difference FROM frequency_sums AS fs JOIN overall_average AS oa ON oa.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE fs.total_count > oa.avg_count
